core_message.en: HitRadar Pro is an end-to-end machine learning system that estimates a song's popularity score (0–100) from audio and metadata features, explains individual predictions using SHAP values, and enables what-if analysis — all packaged as a FastAPI + Streamlit web application.
core_message.vi: HitRadar Pro là một hệ thống machine learning end-to-end ước lượng điểm popularity (0–100) của bài hát từ các đặc trưng âm thanh và metadata, giải thích dự đoán bằng SHAP values, và cho phép phân tích what-if — được đóng gói thành ứng dụng web FastAPI + Streamlit.

what_is_this_project.answer: A web application that predicts how popular a song might be based on its audio features. Built as a student/academic ML project to demonstrate the full ML pipeline: from data to deployed model.

why_does_it_matter.answer: Predicting music popularity from audio features is hard — audio characteristics explain only a small portion of what makes a song popular. This project demonstrates that even with good ML practice (XGBoost, SHAP explainability, full E2E testing), model performance has real limits. It also demonstrates engineering maturity: a real FastAPI backend, a Streamlit frontend, and automated deployment scripts.
why_does_it_matter.evidence_note: R² = 0.07 — model explains ~7% of popularity variance

what_cant_it_do.answer: Predicting commercial success, accounting for artist fame, predicting future releases, replacing human music industry expertise, guaranteeing a song will be popular
what_cant_it_do.why: The model only sees audio features. It cannot see marketing spend, artist brand, playlist placement, or social media virality — which are major drivers of popularity.

key_constraints.dataset: 586672-row ML-ready Spotify-derived sample covering 1900-2021 — historical, platform-specific and not comprehensive
key_constraints.model_r2: 0.07 — low explanatory power, typical for this task
key_constraints.what_if: Prediction comparison only — NOT real-world effect
